get.summary: Public sitemap (index or single urlset) for a site.
get.description: Returns the sitemap index (when the site spans multiple files) or a single urlset document from the ISitemapCache. Supports conditional GET via ETag and If-None-Match; responds 304 when the cached document has not changed.

get.summary: A named child sitemap file for a site.
get.description: Serves a specific child sitemap file referenced by the sitemap index. Supports conditional GET via ETag and If-None-Match. Returns 404 if the named file does not exist in the sitemap cache.

Generates and returns the robots.txt document from the site's SEO defaults. The sitemap URL is automatically appended when a canonical host is configured. Always returns 200 even when no defaults row exists (falls back to an empty allow-all ruleset).

get.summary: PWA web app manifest for a site.
get.description: Returns the web app manifest JSON document built from the site's SEO defaults. Returns 404 when no manifest is configured in the site's SEO defaults.
Returns the site-level SEO defaults that content items inherit when they have no explicit metadata row. Returns 404 if no defaults row has been saved for the site yet.

put.summary: Creates or replaces a site's SEO defaults.
put.description: Inserts a new site SEO defaults row or replaces all fields on the existing one. Fields set here serve as the fallback for every content item on the site that has no explicit metadata row. Returns the saved defaults on success.

post.summary: Forces a rebuild of the site's sitemap on the next read.
post.description: Clears the cached sitemap document for the site so the background job regenerates it on the next read request. Useful after bulk content changes when the scheduled interval is too slow.

get.summary: Gets the raw (pre-cascade) SEO metadata for a content item.
get.description: Returns only the explicitly-saved fields for this content key; fields not saved here fall back through the cascade (site defaults). Returns 404 if no row has been saved yet.

put.summary: Creates or replaces the SEO metadata for a content item.
put.description: Inserts a new SEO metadata row if none exists, or replaces all mutable fields on the existing row. The canonicalUrl must be an absolute HTTPS URL if provided. Validation errors are returned as a 400 problem.

delete.summary: Deletes the SEO metadata so the item falls back to the inherited cascade.
delete.description: Removes the stored SEO row for this content key, causing the content item to inherit all fields from the site defaults going forward. Returns 404 if no row existed.

get.summary: Gets the cascade-resolved, render-ready SEO for a content item.
get.description: Resolves all SEO fields by walking the cascade chain (content row → site defaults → framework fallbacks). The optional contentTitle and contentDescription query parameters seed the resolution when the content row has no explicit title or description. Always returns 200 — missing rows fall back to defaults.

get.summary: Google-style search-result preview for a content item.
get.description: Returns the cascade-resolved title, description, and canonical URL as they would appear in a Google SERP snippet. Pass optional contentTitle and contentDescription query parameters to seed the preview when the content row has no explicit values.

get.summary: Open Graph share-card preview for a content item.
get.description: Returns the cascade-resolved Open Graph fields (type, title, description, image, site name) as they would appear when the page URL is shared on social platforms. Pass optional contentTitle and contentDescription query parameters to seed the preview.

get.summary: JSON-LD @graph the renderer will emit for a content item.
get.description: Builds and returns the JSON-LD structured-data graph exactly as the Next.js renderer will inject it into the page head. Returns 204 when no structured-data providers are registered for this content type or when auto JSON-LD is disabled.

get.summary: Returns a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of SeoMetadata entries.
get.description: Executes a dynamic query against SeoMetadata using the Granit query engine. Accepts filter expressions, sort directives, column selection, pagination, and free-text search via query parameters. Returns a PagedResult by default. When the groupBy query parameter is specified, returns a GroupedResult instead (same status code, different shape).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page index. Ignored when cursor is supplied.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-500). Server-side cap applies.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for keyset pagination. When supplied, overrides page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across searchable columns declared in the query definition.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sort directives. Prefix a field with '-' for descending (e.g. '-createdAt,lastName').

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Field to group results by. When set, the response shape becomes GroupedResult instead of PagedResult.

parameters.name: quickFilters
parameters.description: Comma-separated quick-filter names (declared in the query definition).

parameters.name: skipTotalCount
parameters.description: Skip the total row count for faster pagination when the client doesn't need it.

parameters.name: presets
parameters.description: Bracketed preset selectors: 'presets[group]=name'. Applies preset filter groups declared in the query definition.

schema.description: PagedResult when groupBy is absent; GroupedResult otherwise.

get.summary: Returns query metadata for SeoMetadata (columns, filters, sorts, presets).
get.description: Returns the query definition metadata for SeoMetadata: available columns with display labels and data types, supported filter operators, default sort order, presets, and quick filters. Use this to dynamically build query UIs without hardcoding column definitions.

post.summary: Generates an AI SEO suggestion for one content item.
post.description: Generates AI SEO fields for the specified content item using the configured language model. ContentTitle is required for grounding; ContentBody is optional but improves quality. Returns the created suggestion on success. An identical fingerprint within 7 days reuses the existing suggestion without re-spending tokens. Outcome is Refused, SchemaViolation or TransportFailure when the model declines or the transport fails.

get.summary: Lists AI SEO suggestions for the review inbox, filtered and paginated.
get.description: Returns a page of AI SEO suggestions optionally filtered by siteId, contentType and status. Use skip and take for pagination; take is capped at 100 and defaults to 25.

post.summary: Applies a chosen subset of a suggestion's fields to the live SEO metadata.
post.description: Writes the AI-generated values selected by the Fields mask to the live SEO metadata row for the content item, creating it if it does not exist. The mask is intersected with the suggestion's own scope. Returns 404 when the suggestion does not exist, 409 when it is no longer Pending, and 400 when the selected fields do not overlap with the suggestion's scope.

post.summary: Rejects a pending suggestion, recording an optional reason.
post.description: Marks the suggestion as rejected, recording the reviewer identity, the instant, and an optional dismissal reason. No changes are written to the live SEO metadata. Returns 404 when the suggestion does not exist, 409 when it is no longer Pending.

get.summary: Returns the per-field current-vs-proposed diff for a suggestion.
get.description: Returns a per-field diff comparing the suggestion's proposed values against the content item's current live SEO metadata. Fields in the suggestion but absent from the live row are shown as additions. Use this endpoint to preview the impact of an apply before committing.

post.summary: Queues a bulk SEO generation run for all published content on the site.
post.description: Enqueues a one-off bulk SEO generation job for all published content items on the site that do not yet have SEO metadata. Each item is processed independently; quota exhaustion for one item does not stop the run. Returns 202 Accepted immediately; generated suggestions appear in the review inbox.
